## InvalidReallocationAddressError class

Thrown when a Blue Public Allocator reallocation contains a malformed vault or adapter address.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class InvalidReallocationAddressError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Example


```ts
import { InvalidReallocationAddressError } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const error = new InvalidReallocationAddressError("to.adapter");
if (error instanceof InvalidReallocationAddressError) {
  console.error(error.field);
}
```
